fields.climate: tropical; hot, humid in south; semiarid in north
fields.terrain: gently rolling savanna in north; central hills; southern plateau; low coastal plain with extensive lagoons and marshes
fields.hazards: hot, dry harmattan wind can reduce visibility in north during winter; periodic droughts
fields.farm: cassava, maize, yams, sorghum, soybeans, beans, rice, vegetables, oil palm fruit, cotton
fields.exports: gold, refined petroleum, soybeans, phosphates, coconuts/brazil nuts/cashews
fields.industries: phosphate mining, agricultural processing, cement, handicrafts, textiles, beverages
fields.languages: French (official, language of commerce), Ewe and Mina (in the south), Kabye (sometimes spelled Kabiye) and Dagomba (in the north)
fields.religions: Christian 42.3%, folk religion 36.9%, Muslim 14%, Hindu <1%, Buddhist <1%, Jewish <1%, other <1%, none 6.2%
fields.military: 18-24 years of age for military service for men and women; initial 24-month service obligation; no conscription
